lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Spot diameter increases in the dorsal-posterior direction, while spatial frequency increases ventrally towards the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear features of elevated luminance relative to the base dermis tone intersect with the primary spot clusters to form a rectangular lattice structure across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible extending from the post-branchial region, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, uniform high-luminance spots, providing a distinct contrast to the larger, grid-aligned blobs on the primary lateral flank.
